briefs.markdown:
## WHY THIS MATTERS — Crompton Greaves (DEMO)

All five alternative channels turn positive in the same quarter. **Filings** jump from 5 to 9 disclosures (z **+0.90**) — a capex plant-registration pattern consistent with a **capacity-expansion**. **Factory power** is up **+38%** quarter-on-quarter (15,480 vs 11,200 MWh, z **+0.71**), the strongest absolute delta in the set, and the usual leading indicator of a line running hot before revenue lands. **On-site headcount** climbs **+9%** (3.94k vs 3.62k, z **+0.30**) and **open hiring** surges **+45%** operator/technician roles (128 vs 88, z **+0.58**) — new shifts, not net-new head-office seats.

The **supply-chain** channel is the tension: lead-times compress to an index of 21 from 34 (z **-0.52**), i.e. input availability is tightening exactly as the order book expands. That pairing — **power up + supply-chain tight + filings filing capex** — is the classic "capacity expansion ahead of order-book upturn" signature.

**Read:** composite pulse **82 / 100**, sentiment **+0.71 / 10**. Pre-results, the activity says a new plant/line is commissioning and orders are pulling forward. **Watch item: Q2 energy intensity** — if power keeps climbing while filings cool, the expansion is confirmed; if power rolls back, the order-book upturn is front-loaded.

*DEMO — synthetic numbers; not investment research.*
